title: 401 — an HTLC lock with no access_token cookie
description: The cookie-auth middleware rejects the request before the handler runs. There is no bearer scheme on the Scenario A surface: an Authorization header is ignored, not accepted.
notes: Verified in the delivered gateway middleware (internal/http/middleware/auth.go). A missing cookie gives exactly this body; a present-but-invalid one gives {"error": "invalid token"}. There is no CSRF token anywhere on the platform — SameSite=Strict is the only cross-site mitigation, and inventing an X-CSRF-Token header will simply be ignored.
